1-4 I completely agree, but 5 and 6 lost me. Varied boss and enemy mechanics make the game more interesting, precisely because it limits the characters and strategies you can use on a given level. If every character can beat every level with enough investment, what is even the point of having different strategies? However I agree with your core point that D-Tide difficulty was completely broken by this patch

This is a gacha game, not a single player game. If the unit you’ve spent hundreds of dollars on can’t clear contents and is hard countered everywhere, it feels bad. “Just find another unit to spend hundreds of dollars on” is not really a valid point.

I think we have a fundamental disagreement about how to balance a skill-based game. I don't think you should be able to pay to overcome a hard counter. But in Morimens there are many alternatives to spending money to overcome the challenges in the game, people regularly post 400 D-Tide clears with f2p accounts. So I don't understand the quote about spending hundreds of dollars, or who you are quoting. In any case this convo is a distraction from the core point of the thread, which is that we all dislike the D-Tide changes
